concept.title: Practical Guide: Working with Software Engineers

conbody.p: This practical guide provides concrete, project-ready advice for technical writers collaborating with software engineers. Use this as a template to adapt to your organization's workflows.

section.title: Purpose
section.p: Create clear, developer-focused docs that ship with code, using the project's DITA templates and reuse patterns.

ul.li: Reference — API, CLI flags, formats (use topics/references/).

ol.li: Author topics in the repo near code (use feature branches and small PRs).
Use conrefs for shared warnings/notes and keyrefs for standards/terms.
Run local DITA builds (HTML & PDF) and attach artifacts to PRs.
Assign both a writer and an engineer as reviewers for each doc PR.

ul.li: Use present tense and active voice for tasks.
Include minimal, copy-pasteable examples (shell, JSON, code snippets).
Prefer small, focused topics rather than monolithic docs.

section.title: How to use this file as a template
section.p: Copy this topic to start new project guides, update the Structure & Files section with project-specific mappings, and add concrete examples from the codebase.
